reading_note: The teaching enumerates the complete set of spiritual paths drawn from the boundary-circuit of states: four interior paths of truth that ascend through wisdom into celestial life, and eight exterior paths divided between those which still permit the imprisoned good to be rescued upward, and those reckoned to falsity which descend through the flesh into hell. The arc moves from the source (the encompassing Zone of states), through the differentiation of upward and downward motion, to the manifestation of the downward ways as concrete evils enacted in the body — lawlessness, murder, the wounding word, mockery of what is divine — which are the natural ultimates of the hells.
